data.one_liner: Widgets to animate between number or string text values.
data.what_it_does: Provides simple widgets like AnimatedNumberText and AnimatedStringText that automatically animate when their values change. They support custom curves, durations, text styles, and number formatting.
use_when: You need to animate number increases or decreases like currency values.
You want to animate text content changes where characters lerp to new values.
You want a familiar animated widget experience similar to Flutter's pre-built animated widgets.
avoid_when: You require complex particle-based or physics-driven motion graphics like Rive or Lottie.
You are animating things other than numbers or text strings.
strengths: Simple API similar to standard Flutter animated widgets.
Supports formatting for numbers and currency values.
weaknesses: Limited to text and number lerping animations.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive, chainable animation system for all kinds of widgets including text effects.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Better suited for complex vector animations designed by motion designers.

data.minimal_example:
AnimatedNumberText(
  value,
  curve: Curves.easeIn,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 30),
)
